snippet.sync_client:
from seed import SeedApi

client = SeedApi()
client.items.create_item(
    name="name",
)
snippet.async_client:
import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedApi

client = AsyncSeedApi()


async def main() -> None:
    await client.items.create_item(
        name="name",
    )


asyncio.run(main())
